name: 老板智囊
description: 为企业老板生成可用于商业判断的研究报告，覆盖行业、产品、竞品、客户、市场和政策研究。

roadmap.v0: GPT-only report generation with fixed research workflow.
roadmap.v1: Add Firecrawl or Tavily search results as source material.
roadmap.v2: Add planner, evidence review, and citation quality checks.
roadmap.v3: Split planning, search, evidence, writing, and review into multiple agents.
